content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sharing the agreement. I am excited to get started, but I would like to propose a few minor adjustments to the terms before signing: - Regarding the scope changes, the relevant clause requires accommodating changes without additional pay within the overall project budget; I propose that any changes or additions to the scope of Services instead be agreed upon in writing by both parties and documented in a change order specifying corresponding adjustments to fees and timelines. - Regarding the revision rounds, the agreement allows an excessive number of revision rounds before additional charges apply; I propose providing up to three rounds of revisions for the principal creative Deliverables, with any further revisions subject to additional fees. - Regarding the payment terms, the relevant clause sets payment to Net 60, which creates a significant delay in receiving funds; I propose that invoices be payable Net 30. Please let me know if these updates work for you. Best regards,
